The session focused on refining and correcting demographic data used for analytics. Initially, it was noted that the available data for income and education were not comprehensive across all residents, requiring specific adjustments.

[p1] provided a structured approach involving three steps: 1) Combining Education and Income data; 2) Joining country data in Recalc; and 3) Injecting demographic data into Recalc. [me] subsequently found an easier method by directly correcting the data structure, which [p1] confirmed was effective for inclusion in queries.

[p1] reviewed the resulting figures using several facilities, noting that the numbers looked good.
decisions: The demographic data correction process was completed and deemed accurate for use in analytics.
